description: This bar chart illustrates the number of conversations related to different topics—Academic Collaboration, Recruitment, Academic Funding, and Journalism—categorized by whether the response was “Yes,” “Partially,” or “No.” The categories are displayed on the vertical axis, listed in the order of Academic Collaboration, Recruitment, Academic Funding, and Journalism, without an apparent sorting method. The horizontal axis represents the “Number of Conversations,” with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. Each topic is represented by a set of three horizontally arranged bars, one for each response category. The “Yes” responses are represented by red bars, “Partially” by yellow bars, and “No” by green bars. For Academic Collaboration, the “Yes” bar extends to approximately 58, the “Partially” bar to approximately 12, and the “No” bar to approximately 6. For Recruitment, the “Yes” bar extends to approximately 55, the “Partially” bar to approximately 15, and the “No” bar to approximately 3. For Academic Funding, the “Yes” bar extends to approximately 15, the “Partially” bar to approximately 25, and the “No” bar to approximately 5. For Journalism, the “Yes” bar extends to approximately 10, the “Partially” bar to approximately 48, and the “No” bar to approximately 5. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlines, or annotations.
